description: A Claude seat without the required command wrapper exhausts the chain that names it. check reports UNRESOLVED: ChainExhaustedError and exits 3.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.primary]
kind = "claude"
short = "pr"
config_dir_var = "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
config_dir = "{{DIR:claude-home}}"
pool = "claude:primary"

[roles.scout]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.scout.models]
claude = "m"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
scout = ["primary"]
